description: This file defines the class CalendarSyncOperationDiscovery which is responsible for analyzing source and target calendar events and determining synchronization operations such as create, update, or delete to reconcile differences. It contains methods for discovering sync operations based on event comparison and conflict resolution strategies.

classes.name: CalendarSyncOperationDiscovery
classes.description: Class responsible for analyzing calendar events and generating synchronization operations between source and target calendars.

methods.name: discoverSyncOperations
methods.description: Main method to compare source and target events, determine the differences, and generate appropriate sync operations.

methods.description: Helper method for creating a new CalendarSyncOperation instance with specified parameters.
